About Us
PANDIT DEENDAYAL UPADHYAYA ADARSHA MAHAVIDYALAYA, AMJONGA was established at Amjonga in the district of Goalpara under the co-venture of the Central Government and the Government of Assam with the financial assistance from centrally sponsored scheme - Rashtriya Uchchatar Shiksha Abhiyan (RUSA). The institution was named after Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya, a great thinker, philosopher and a renowned sociologist of the country.
